verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair axis for a CRM platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack only documents RESTful APIs, general 'API and integration support', and workflow automations. None of these describes registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscriptions, and the API-docs probes returned 404, offering no further detail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
